features.quote: West and north of this structure are three large, hewn, plastered cisterns

notes: Three cisterns (data block 'Cisterns: 3' = the same three; not double-counted). The text places them 'west and north' of the central 6x15 m structure, not of the site, so relative_to other. f1 = the 'northern cistern'; f2 = the other two, taken as the western ones by elimination. Plan fig. 310 (north arrow upper left, 0-5 m bar) agrees: collapsed cistern about N of the structure, the two others about W-WSW. No grid on the plan, so the unit point cannot be placed; no plan position. Cemented catchment surfaces descending to the cisterns are not pools. No graves.
